From: Veronica's Secrets lingerie
To: Alice Simpson
Date: 01/02/2026
Subject: Order Confirmation
Dear Alice Simpson,
This is to acknowledge receipt of the order you placed with Veronica's Secrets Lingerie on February 1. Your order confirmation number is HY93072. If you wish to contact us for any reason relating to your order, you will need to provide the above confirmation number.
The aquamarine bathrobe and matching sleepers you requested are currently in stock and should be delivered within 5 days of the order date. However, the pink/red striped silk pajama set is backordered until February 10. Should you still wish to purchase it, it will be shipped to you within the next 2 weeks. As soon as the currently available items are shipped, you will receive an email with details about the date and shipping method as well as the estimated delivery date.
For your convenience, you can track the status of your order online by logging in to your account at www.veronicassecrets.com. There you can check the status of your order, review estimated delivery dates, cancel unshipped items, and contact customer service 24 hours a day. You can also call our customer service number at 1-800-566-8008. Services are available Monday through Sunday from 8:00 A.M. until 8:00 P. M.
Thank you once again for shopping with Veronica's Secrets Lingerie.
Sincerely
Veronica's Secrets Online Sales Department

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of this e-mail?

options.A: To confirm the cancellation of a purchase
options.B: To let the customer know the exact delivery date
options.C: To tell the customer that the items are out of stock
options.D: To confirm that a customer's order is being processed well

questions.analysis: What is the main purpose of this e-mail? 原文依据：Subject: Order Confirmation；This is to acknowledge receipt of the order… 这封邮件是订单确认邮件，告知顾客订单已收到并正在处理。 A：取消订单 → 错误 B：告知确切送达日期 → 不是主要目的 C：告知商品缺货 → 只是部分内容 D：确认顾客订单正在顺利处理 → 正确

questions.analysis: What do customers need to know in case they have questions about their orders? 原文依据：If you wish to contact us for any reason relating to your order, you will need to provide the above confirmation number. 咨询订单问题时，需要提供订单确认号。 A：商品编码 → 错误 B：确认号码 → 正确 C：配送详情 → 错误 D：送达日期 → 错误

options.A: Within 5 days from the order date
options.C: On the shipment of the purchased products
